map.债务/欠款诉讼时效计算器 使用指南: Debt / Arrears Limitation Period Calculator User Guide
map.针对借款、欠款类纠纷，输入借款到期或违约起算时间，计算诉讼时效届满日，并提示时效: For loan and arrears disputes, enter the maturity or default start time to compute the expiry of the limitation period and prompts for interruption and suspension, helping creditors time dunning and filing.
map.填写「对方最近承诺还款日期」。: Enter "the counterparty's most recent promised repayment date".
map.借条约定了还款日期，从届满日起算 3 年，计算丧失胜诉权的风险日。: When the loan fixes a repayment date, the 3-year period runs from the due date; use this to assess the risk of losing the right to sue.
map.未约定还款期的，可随时主张，时效从第一次催款之日起算 3 年。: When no repayment date is fixed, the claim can be made at any time and the 3-year period runs from the first dunning.
map.催款、部分还款、对方承诺还款均构成时效中断，重新计算 3 年。: Dunning, partial repayment or a promise to repay all interrupt the period, restarting the 3 years.
map.约定还款日情形: When a repayment date is agreed
map.：借条约定 2023-06-01 还款，时效自次日起算 3 年，届满 2026-: : the IOU fixes repayment on 2023-06-01, so the 3-year period runs from the next day and expires 2026-06-01; with no prior demand or filing, enforcement becomes difficult once it expires.
map.：2024-06-01 书面催款并保留证据，时效自该日重新计算 3 年，新届满日: : a written demand on 2024-06-01 with evidence retained restarts the 3-year period, so the new expiry is 2027-06-01; with multiple demands the last one governs.
map.没有借条只有转账记录能算时效吗？: Can the limitation period be computed from transfer records alone without an IOU?
map.转账记录可证明借贷关系，但起算点需结合聊天记录、催款证据确定；建议补写借条或留存: Transfer records can prove the lending relationship, but the starting point must be established together with chat logs and dunning evidence; it is advisable to write a proper IOU or keep dunning receipts to lock the period.
map.超过 3 年就彻底要不回了吗？: After 3 years is it completely unrecoverable?
map.时效届满丧失的是胜诉权而非债权，对方自愿履行的有效；若对方不提出时效抗辩，法院不: What expires at limitation is the right to sue, not the claim itself, and voluntary performance by the counterparty remains valid; if the counterparty does not raise the limitation defence the court will not apply it sua sponte, so recovery may still be possible.
